items.title: Pay 'directory entry' invoice
items.quote: Der Betrag von 569,06 € ist bis zum 16.09.2027 zu überweisen.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar due date (16.09.2027) rather than a period to count. This is a private commercial sender, not a public authority, so no delivery-fiction rules apply and the printed date is used as written. 16 September 2027 falls on a Thursday, a normal working day in NRW, so no weekend/holiday shift under §193 BGB is needed.

warnings: This letter closely matches the well-known German 'Gewerbeauskunft'/business-directory scam pattern: it is styled as an official-looking 'Eintragungsbestätigung' (confirmation of registration), but the fine print states 'Die Eintragung ist ein Angebot; mit Ihrer Zahlung nehmen Sie es an' — meaning this is in fact merely an unsolicited commercial offer, and paying it would create a 24-month advertising contract you likely never ordered, not settle an existing debt.

The bank account is held in the name 'BRM Verlagsservice Ltd.', which does not match the sender printed in the letterhead ('Branchenregister Musterland – Verzeichnisservice') — a mismatch typical of these scams.

The letter uses pressure tactics (threatening to pass the matter to a debt-collection agency 'ohne weitere Mahnung' immediately after a very short 7-day deadline) despite there being no underlying contract or legal obligation shown; the recommended action is not to pay and, if desired, to write back rejecting the 'offer' rather than transferring money.
'Branchenregister Musterland' is a private commercial entity, not a public business register (e.g. Handelsregister), despite the official-sounding name.
